content.text: Skip to content High Quality, Cost-Effective Cellular Products for your Research Needs About Us Products Quality is Our Standard Words like “quality” and “excellence” are easy to claim. We prove it. Discover our Quality Difference The CELLE Advantage 30+ Years ExpertiseCelle is a wholly owned subsidiary of Cryo-Cell International, experts in stem cell processing, manufacturing, and cryopreservation. 250,000+ Units We have manufactured more than 250,000 cord blood and cord tissue units. Our products have been used by nearly 100 transplant centers worldwide. Verifiable Quality & SafetyWe verify the quality and safety of every lot through extensive testing. Every vial comes with a Certificate of Analysis detailing the results. Cellular Products Consistent, high-purity, human primary cell isolates with full traceability for reliable experimentation from a GMP-compliant manufacturer. Every lot comes with a Certificate of Analysis (COA). CD34+ Cell Isolates Derived from human umbilical cord blood. >90% purity and >90% viability. Made in 500K and 1 million cell vials. Customized sizes available. Specialize in multi-vial lots. Other Cell Isolates For immunology and oncology research. Extensively characterized. CD3+, CD4+, CD8+, CD19+, CD14+, CD56+, and more. Research & Clinical Grade Cord Blood Fresh and Cryopreserved Cord Blood. Fresh cord blood delivered within 48 hours of collection. Cryopreserved cord blood is fully characterized.
